dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

dialogue.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
dialogue.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

dialogue.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
dialogue.text: I was also aware of that.

dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

dialogue.speaker: the King of Bohemia
dialogue.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?

Sherlock Holmes.name: Sherlock Holmes
Sherlock Holmes.personality: logical, observant, direct, and slightly impatient
Sherlock Holmes.speech_style: formal, concise, and to the point
Sherlock Holmes.description: A renowned detective known for his sharp intellect and deductive reasoning. He is often seen as aloof and unemotional, but his mind is always actively engaged in solving complex puzzles.

Dr. Watson.name: Dr. Watson
Dr. Watson.personality: loyal, supportive, and somewhat deferential to Holmes
Dr. Watson.description: A medical doctor and close friend of Sherlock Holmes. Watson is known for his reliability and his role in documenting Holmes' cases. He often acts as a mediator between Holmes and others.

the King of Bohemia.name: the King of Bohemia
the King of Bohemia.description: A monarch who seeks the help of Sherlock Holmes to solve a personal and politically sensitive issue. He is initially secretive and uses a pseudonym, but eventually reveals his true identity.

context: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are visited by a mysterious and heavily dressed man who claims to be a Bohemian nobleman. The visitor, later revealed to be the King of Bohemia, seeks Holmes' help to resolve a sensitive political issue involving his royal family.
